scope: Real Chromium interaction with local mocked public feeds and empty/error private data. No real authenticated investor/member session, private data, authorization decision, subscription or delivery tested.

checks.name: canonical Desk URL works on local/staging origins without linking away
first actual release opens the existing modal
feed text is escaped rather than executed
modal identifies actual publication date
acknowledgement records actual content identity
an acknowledged release is checked again but stays closed
a later release remains discoverable after an earlier acknowledgement
later release has a different acknowledgement identity
regeneration timestamp alone does not announce the same content again
failed feed stays unavailable without a fabricated announcement
successful empty feed remains honestly empty
private empty state offers a real next action
investor theme selector changes the actual page palette
theme selection persists through reload
private query errors stay distinct from empty updates/documents
activity error is unavailable rather than no activity
unavailable metrics render dashes rather than invented zeros
rejected activity request resolves to an explicit unavailable state
returned and rejected private queries cause no unhandled page exception
mobile admin retains a visible portal return link
